sentences.en: They will use an innovative technique to perform such a task.
sentences.zh: 他们将采用一种创新的技术来完成这项任务。

sentences.en: That was a very innovative way to do that.
sentences.zh: 那是一种非常新颖的做法。

sentences.en: The company stormed the market with its innovative products.
sentences.zh: 该公司凭借其创新产品迅速占领了市场。

senses.zh: 新发明的, 新引进的; 革新的; 有改革精神的 乐于引进新观念的
